issues.reason: Cleyran heritage substitutes stats and Perform (Dance) for Keen Senses; Keen Senses-consuming alternates must substitute correctly, especially Market Dweller/Skulk. Cleyran Ancestry alternate is DISTINCT from Cleyran heritage.
Quick Reactions directly grants Improved Initiative; conditional HP-melee/AC, multi-round Cleyran Ancestry trigger, scent, primary/secondary claws and Unnatural animal type require runtime review.
15 favored options need class reconciliation, including double Bard +1/6 reward, Ninja 5-ft speed rounding increments and summon/companion targets.
Staging-only source paraphrases and effects are not independent rules approval; source text is not bundled or licensed. Live wizard and sheet behavior has not been tested.

Source race page names high-INT options but does not spell out count/reselection mechanics; formula max(0, INT_MOD) is a provisional standard-system interpretation only, not approved for auto-application.

Standard testing supports printed DEX/INT/CHA scores, identity, Perception, darkvision, seven optional languages and owned +1 CMD. Quick Reactions grants an Improved Initiative manual card; numeric feat effects await verified feat rules. Jump-only Acrobatics, fear saves and claw primary/secondary handling remain manual. Variants/alternates and independent full review pending.

features.name: Ability Score Adjustment
features.description: +2 Dexterity, +2 Intelligence, −2 Charisma.

features.name: Size
features.description: Medium.

features.name: Type
features.description: Humanoid with burmecian subtype.

features.name: Base Speed
features.description: 30-foot land speed.

features.name: Languages
features.description: Starts with Common and Burmecian; high-INT options: Draconic, Dwarven, Elvaan, Galkan, Giant, Goblin, Orc.

features.name: Battle-Hardened
features.description: +1 bonus to CMD.

features.name: Fearless
features.description: +2 racial saving throws versus fear spells and effects.

features.name: Keen Senses
features.description: +2 racial Perception.

features.name: Natural Jumper
features.description: +4 racial Acrobatics, only to jump.

features.name: Quick Reactions
features.description: Gain Improved Initiative as a racial bonus feat.

effects.textValue: Grant Improved Initiative directly; normal feat prerequisites are not imposed on a granted racial bonus feat. Link to canonical feat when available.

features.name: Darkvision
features.description: Darkvision 60 feet.

features.name: Claws
features.description: Pair of 1d4 damage claw natural attacks; primary when unarmed/unarmed weapons, secondary when using manufactured weapons.

effects.textValue: Two claw attacks, 1d4 each; primary normally, secondary when wielding manufactured weapons.

features.name: Cleyran Ancestry
features.description: After a successful Diplomacy attempt to win a person over, that person receives −2 on attempts to resist any Charisma-based skills of the burmecian for the next 24 hours. Replaces Fearless.

effects.textValue: After successful Diplomacy to win target over, target −2 to resist character CHA-based checks for 24 h; target-specific duration.

features.name: Cornered Fury
features.description: At half HP or below, with no conscious ally within 30 ft, +2 racial melee attack rolls and +2 racial AC. Replaces Battle-Hardened and Quick Reactions.

condition.description: HP at or below 50% AND no conscious ally within 30 feet
HP at or below 50% AND no conscious ally within 30 feet

features.name: Jumper
features.description: Always considered to have a running start for Acrobatics jumping checks. Replaces Keen Senses.

effects.textValue: Jump checks always count as having a running start.

features.name: Market Dweller
features.description: +2 racial Bluff and Sleight of Hand. Replaces Keen Senses and Natural Jumper.

features.name: Mountain-Born
features.description: +2 racial Acrobatics for narrow ledges, +2 racial saves versus altitude fatigue/sickness. Replaces Fearless.

features.name: Mountaineer Training
features.description: Immune altitude sickness; retain DEX bonus to AC when climbing or crossing narrow/slippery surfaces via Acrobatics. Climb and Acrobatics class skills. Replaces Keen Senses.

effects.textValue: Immune altitude sickness and preserve DEX-to-AC while climbing/crossing narrow/slippery surfaces.
Existing Climb row becomes a class skill.
Existing Acrobatics row becomes a class skill.

features.name: Plagueborn
features.description: +2 racial saving throws vs disease, ingested poisons, nausea and sickness. Replaces Fearless.

condition.description: Disease, ingested poisons, nauseated or sickened status

features.name: Rodent Empathy
features.description: +4 racial Handle Animal checks to influence rodents. Replaces Natural Jumper.

features.name: Scent
features.description: Gain scent special ability; −2 Perception checks based primarily on sight or hearing. Replaces Keen Senses.

condition.description: Checks based primarily on seeing or hearing

features.name: Skulk
features.description: +2 racial Stealth; when hiding from a creature distracted using Bluff, Stealth penalty is −5 instead of normal −10. Replaces Claws, Keen Senses and Natural Jumper.

effects.textValue: When hiding from creatures you distracted with Bluff, penalty is −5 rather than −10.

features.name: Unnatural
features.description: −4 to ALL Charisma-based skill checks to influence Animal-type creatures; +2 dodge AC vs animals; animal starting attitude one category worse. Replaces Battle-Hardened.

effects.textValue: Animal starting attitude toward burmecian one step worse than normal.

features.name: Cleyran heritage ability adjustments
features.description: Heritage ability adjustments: {'con': 2, 'cha': 2, 'str': -2}. Apply instead of the standard racial ability adjustment, never in addition. Perform (Dance) +2 racial replaces Keen Senses +2 Perception.

features.description: Cleyran swaps Perception racial skill bonus to Perform (Dance); still retains all other standard features unless separately replaced.
